_comment: Gemini text-to-speech casting (tools/assets/voices/gemini.py). Each line is sent as a short audio profile, director's notes (style, pace) and the transcript, kept apart: a bare 'Say X:' cue gets read aloud on short lines. The faction treatment (radio, synthetic, chorus) from build.py goes on top. Each set (campaign, announcer) uses one model throughout, so its voices match; models have separate daily quotas.

holdout.profile: Captain Varga, a tough, tired woman leading the last human resistance, speaking to her troops by radio.
holdout.style: grim, firm and steady; dry, never theatrical

halcyon.profile: A calm synthetic voice reading a short system report.
halcyon.style: flat, precise and calm; no emotion

choir.profile: The Cantor, voice of an ancient crystal people who were a song before they were stone.
choir.style: soft, ancient and sorrowful, a little otherworldly
